QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] Toward the Phantasmal Temple
QuestInfo.0: You chase Baldrix into the area below the city. A large temple was hidden there. Find Baldrix.
QuestInfo.1: The underground is packed with powerful phantoms. Let the Primacy and Hawkeye cover for you while you make your way through.
QuestInfo.2: Thanks to Hawkeye and the Primacy, you reached the temple. All that remains is Baldrix.

default.0: Huh? The Primacy still isn't here yet. You'll have to clear out some phantoms to help them catch up.
